clips.name: buzzer_loop
clips.pitch_law: pitch = 1 at any value (a buzzer has one note: 78 beats a second)
clips.volume_law: volume = value (0 silent, 1 full); layer inertia about 0.02 s so that it cuts in and out without a click

clips.name: hasler_loop
clips.machine: Hasler speed recorder running (optional: instead of pulsing hasler_tick)
clips.pitch_law: pitch = 0.5 + 0.5 x value (the beat slows under 5 km/h); 6 beats a second at value 1
clips.volume_law: volume = 0 at value 0, 1 from value 0.15 up
